laws.rule: Danube Delta Biosphere Reserve: tourist access permit 5 lei for 1 day, 15 lei for 7 days, 30 lei to the end of the year; free for pupils, students, pensioners, people with disabilities and local residents. Vehicle permit 10 lei a day or 100 lei a year; boat permit 20 lei for 7 days or 100 lei a year; all valid only with the tourist permit. (No RBA rate for RON; at the Banca Națională a României rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 3.355 RON: 5 lei ≈ A$1.49; 15 lei ≈ A$4.47; 30 lei ≈ A$8.94; 100 lei ≈ A$29.81)
